sections.title: Chile: From Desert Skies to Southern Shores
sections.subtitle: An Adult Wellness Adventure from the Atacama Desert to the Southern Lake District
sections.html:
Discover a different rhythm of life on this 10-day journey through Chile, where colorful coastal cities, vast desert landscapes, and lush southern forests offer space to reconnect with nature and yourself. Designed for adults who find renewal through movement, discovery, and meaningful experiences, this journey combines guided walks, local cuisine, cultural encounters, and moments of quiet wonder.

Begin in Santiago, explore the artistic streets of Valparaíso, and travel north to the Atacama Desert for flamingo-filled lagoons, sunrise geysers, and an evening beneath the stars. Then journey south to Puerto Varas, where island traditions, flowing rivers, and ancient trees reveal another side of Chile. Along the way, wellness takes shape through fresh air, nourishing meals, shared experiences, and time to appreciate the world around you.

sections.title: Day 1- Arrive & Find Your Rhythm
sections.html:
Arrive in Santiago, Chile’s capital, and settle into your hotel before beginning a guided introduction to the city. Experience Santiago through everyday local life, riding the subway past stations featuring public art and exploring a lively market filled with seafood, fruits, and vegetables. Continue to Plaza de Armas, the historic central square, where grand buildings introduce the city’s architectural heritage. Taste Chilean specialties such as empanadas and fruit-based drinks as you explore. If time and energy allow, continue to Bellavista, a neighborhood known for its colorful streets and creative atmosphere. Gather for dinner at the hotel before a restful evening.

Overnight: Almasur Providencia or similar. Dinner included.

sections.title: Day 2- Color, Creativity & Coastal Connection
sections.html:
After breakfast at the hotel, travel to Valparaíso, a coastal city where hillside neighborhoods, vibrant murals, and winding streets create an open-air celebration of creativity. Your guide will introduce the artists, cultural influences, and local stories behind the city’s street art, with tastings of regional dishes and drinks along the way. Enjoy an included lunch at a restaurant overlooking the city before visiting La Sebastiana, the former home of poet Pablo Neruda. Its distinctive rooms and views offer a glimpse into his imaginative world. Return to Santiago for dinner at the hotel.

Overnight: Almasur Providencia or similar. Breakfast, lunch, and dinner included.

sections.title: Day 3- Into the Desert, Beneath an Endless Sky
sections.html:
After breakfast at the hotel, transfer to Santiago’s airport for your flight to Calama, followed by a guided transfer to San Pedro de Atacama, your base for exploring Chile’s northern desert. Begin your desert experience in Moon Valley, where dunes, salt formations, and rugged ridges create an extraordinary landscape. Learn about the area’s salt-mining history and its connections to the Atacameño, or Lickanantai, people as you explore Victoria Mine and the natural formations known as the Three Marys. Continue to Mars Valley for sunset, pausing for a celebratory toast as changing light transforms the surrounding earth. Return to the hotel for dinner.

Overnight: La Casa de Don Tomás or similar. Breakfast and dinner included.

sections.title: Day 4- Desert Life & the Art of Slowing Down
sections.html:
After breakfast at the hotel, discover the Atacama Salt Flat, where expansive salt landscapes and distant mountains invite a sense of perspective and stillness. Visit Chaxa Lagoon to observe flamingos feeding in the shallow waters, then explore Toconao, a village known for its stone architecture, historic bell tower, and local handicrafts. An included boxed lunch supports a full day of discovery. Continue with a guided hike of approximately four kilometers through Guatín’s Cactus Valley, following the Vilama River gorge through a landscape of towering cacti and desert vegetation. Listen to flowing water, observe the life sustained by this oasis, and enjoy the simple pleasure of moving through nature. Return to your hotel for dinner.

Overnight: La Casa de Don Tomás or similar. Breakfast, boxed lunch, and dinner included.

sections.title: Day 5- Sunrise Steam & Starlit Wonder
sections.html:
Set out early for El Tatio, a high-altitude geothermal landscape where rising columns of steam meet the cold morning air. Breakfast timing will be arranged around the early departure. Take in the dramatic scenery before continuing to Machuca, a small village that introduces the traditions and daily life of the Andean highlands. Enjoy lunch at a local restaurant, with a starter, main course, dessert, and beverage included, then return to San Pedro de Atacama for time to rest. Dinner at the hotel and an evening astronomy experience complete the day. With expert guidance and powerful telescopes, explore the visible night sky while learning how local cultures have understood their relationship with the stars.

Overnight: La Casa de Don Tomás or similar. Breakfast, lunch, and dinner included. Astronomical observations depend on sky conditions.

sections.title: Day 6- From Desert Stillness to Lakeside Calm
sections.html:
After breakfast at the hotel, transfer to Calama’s airport for your onward flight journey to Puerto Montt, followed by a guided transfer to Puerto Varas. This welcoming town in Chile’s southern Lake District provides a striking change of scenery after the desert, with green landscapes and a gentler lakeside atmosphere. Settle into your hotel and, as arrival time allows, enjoy a quiet afternoon or an easy stroll before gathering for dinner. Today offers a chance to pause, recharge, and prepare for the next chapter of your journey.

Overnight: Weisserhaus Hotel or similar. Breakfast and dinner included.

sections.title: Day 7- Island Traditions & Stories by the Sea
sections.html:
After breakfast at the hotel, depart for a full-day exploration of Chiloé, an island known for its wooden churches, maritime traditions, and distinctive houses built on stilts over the water. Cross the Chacao Channel by ferry, watching for seabirds and marine wildlife along the way. Explore Chacao and Dalcahue, where waterfront markets, local crafts, and traditional architecture introduce island life. Continue to Castro to admire its colorful palafitos from the Gamboa viewpoint, visit San Francisco Church, and browse the handicraft market. Enjoy an included lunch during the excursion, with its location arranged around the day’s route. In Ancud, discover San Antonio Fort and other local highlights before returning to Puerto Varas for dinner.

Overnight: Weisserhaus Hotel or similar. Breakfast, lunch, and dinner included.

sections.title: Day 8- Among Ancient Trees & Living Waters
sections.html:
After breakfast at the hotel, journey toward Alerce Andino National Park, passing coastal scenery near Puerto Montt before entering a world of deep green forest. Following a park orientation, begin a guided walk toward the Chaica River Falls, accompanied by the sounds of rushing water and birdsong. Ferns, flowers, and changing forest textures provide plenty of reasons to pause along the trail. At the falls, take time to rest and appreciate the clear water flowing over the rocks before continuing to an ancient alerce tree. Standing beneath its towering canopy offers a quiet moment of reflection on time, resilience, and the natural world. Enjoy an included lunch during the excursion and return to the hotel for dinner.

Overnight: Weisserhaus Hotel or similar. Breakfast, lunch, and dinner included.

sections.title: Day 9- Return, Reflect & Celebrate
sections.html:
After breakfast at the hotel, transfer to Puerto Montt’s airport for your flight back to Santiago. Meet your guide on arrival and transfer to your hotel for your final evening in Chile. Depending on flight schedules, enjoy time to relax or take a leisurely neighborhood walk. Gather at a local restaurant for a farewell dinner, celebrating the landscapes explored, experiences shared, and connections formed throughout the journey. From desert horizons to ancient forests, each destination has offered its own invitation to slow down and pay attention.

Overnight: Almasur Providencia or similar. Breakfast and dinner included.

sections.title: Day 10- Carry the Calm Home
sections.html:
Enjoy breakfast at the hotel before your private transfer to Santiago’s airport for your international flight home. Depart with memories of colorful coastal streets, desert sunsets, star-filled skies, and peaceful forest paths—and inspiration to bring more movement, curiosity, and moments of stillness into everyday life.

Breakfast included.

sections.title: What is included
sections.html:
What Is Included

  • International round-trip airfare.

  • Domestic flights required for the itinerary between Santiago, Calama, and Puerto Montt.

  • Nine nights of accommodations at the listed hotels or similar properties.

  • Daily breakfast, with timing adjusted for early departures when necessary.

  • Dinner on Days 1–9, including a farewell dinner at a local restaurant in Santiago.

  • Lunch on Days 2, 4, 5, 7, and 8, including a boxed lunch on Day 4.

  • Private airport transfers and ground transportation for scheduled excursions.

  • English-speaking guides for the scheduled transfers and guided experiences.

  • Guided Santiago city exploration and the Valparaíso street art excursion.

  • La Sebastiana Museum visit when open, with an alternative on Mondays.

  • Guided visits to Moon Valley, Mars Valley, the Atacama Salt Flat, Chaxa Lagoon, and Toconao.

  • Guided hiking in Guatín’s Cactus Valley.

  • El Tatio Geysers and Machuca excursion.

  • Guided astronomical experience with telescope observations, conditions permitting.

  • Chiloé Island excursion, including the scheduled ferry crossing.

  • Guided Alerce Andino National Park excursion.

  • Entrance fees for the scheduled visits and activities.

  • Food tastings and the sunset toast described in the itinerary.

What Is Not Included

  • Lunch on Days 1, 3, 6, 9, and 10.

  • Meals outside those specified, including meals during international travel unless provided by the airline.

  • Additional beverages or alcoholic drinks beyond those expressly included.

  • Gratuities for guides, drivers, and hotel staff.

  • Travel insurance.

  • Passport expenses and any applicable visa or entry fees.

  • Optional excursions and activities outside the itinerary.

  • Personal purchases, laundry, room service, and other incidental expenses.

  • Airline baggage fees unless included in the final airfare package.
